title: Finding the Third Side of a Triangle Using the Law of Cosines (C = 60 Degrees)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A triangle has sides of length a = 2 and b = 3 with an included angle of C = 60^\circ. Find the exact length of the opposite side c.

steps.title: State the Law of Cosines for Side c
steps.explanation: Relate the unknown side c to the two known sides a, b and their included angle C using the Law of Cosines.
steps.why: The Law of Cosines determines the third side of a triangle in any SAS (side-angle-side) configuration.

steps.title: Substitute a = 2, b = 3, and C = 60 Degrees
steps.explanation: Substitute the given side lengths and cos(60^circ) = 1/2 to find c^2 = 7.

steps.title: Take the Positive Square Root
steps.explanation: Since side length c must be positive, take the principal square root c = sqrt(7) approx 2.65.
steps.why: Geometric lengths are strictly positive quantities.
